d: Pakistan is buying 100,000 Merkut First-Person-View FPV attack drones from Turkey. Along with these, the Pakistani Army is also getting unmanned helicopters and other kamikaze and surveillance drones from Turkey. As per the deal signed with Turkey's Pasifik Teknologi, Pakistan's National Radio Telecommunication Corporation (NRTC), the drones will be made in Pakistan over a 3-year period. Pakistan has previously used Turkish drones against, during Operation Sindoor in 2025 when the Yiha III drone was shot down by Indian Armed Forces.
